svg.title: Copy the input list into every cell of a fixed coarse tiling, with its specified reflection and translation, writing Fv,i for copied insertions and qv = Q i Fv,i. The anchor copy is unchanged. At m + 1 all original members have parent zero, so copied parents are exactly the tiling centers. At every finer level a copied position has its center’s coarser parent and lies within half the intervening
